title: C4Container diagram - Container diagram for Internet Banking System
notes: Canonical C4Container example from the official mermaid docs (docs/syntax/c4.md), itself adapted from the well-known Structurizr/C4-model 'Internet Banking System' reference example, expressed in mermaid's C4 syntax (PlantUML-compatible). Nodes: Customer, E-Mail System, Mainframe Banking System, Single-Page App, Mobile App, Web Application, Database, API Application. 11 Rel()/Rel_Back() relationships, all directed.
